entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor I bought. I... I think I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I please have your full name and order number?
Of course. The name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... VF78-29110-B. I'm a VIP member, if that helps at all.

Thank you, Ms. Jenkins. I see your account right here, and yes, thank you for being one of our VIP members. I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 25th. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?

Oh, it works fine, there's nothing wrong with it. To be honest, I just... I **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** after Christmas, and I really **don't use it** nearly as much as I thought I would. I just feel so guilty looking at it, and I really needed this money back. I was so worried I'd be stuck trying to use some online **resale** marketplace.
I completely understand, and I appreciate your honesty. It's important that you're happy with your VeloFit products. Let me just take a quick look at our return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, yes, I've just checked the policy. You're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window, so we can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That is such a huge relief. I was so stressed about this. Thank you so much, Alex! You've really helped me out.

You are very welcome, Ms. Jenkins. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label. Just place the device back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any local post office.
That's perfect. Thank you again for being so understanding.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help.
Wonderful. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
